generalNotes: This file print was made in 1952, per a note of May 2, 1952 in which George Tames, photographer for the Washington Bureau of the Times, stated that the National Archives is given permission to distribute prints of photographs taken by NYT staff. The print supplied by the New York Times is in series 64-PR, file 139.
